title: Continuity of the Gaussian pair torus map
statement: For each natural number $n$, the map from pairs $(x,y)$ of vectors in $\mathbb R^n$ to the product torus indexed by the disjoint union of two copies of $\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}$, obtained by applying the Gaussian torus map to each vector, is continuous.
